prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1237; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck and back pain. Symptoms are consistent in location and character with the mechanism of injury, and the reported force of the impact is in keeping with soft tissue strain of the cervical and lumbar regions. Examination at the first visit showed paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted range of motion in the neck and lower back. Imaging obtained during treatment clearly confirms the soft tissue injury. The patient's history includes a remote, minor strain involving the same region, which resolved completely with conservative care and had no lasting effect on function. Treatment consisted of two visits with a conservative plan including gentle stretching, home exercise instruction, and as-needed analgesics. Care followed a typical course and tapered as the patient improved, with pain and mobility steadily returning toward baseline. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no repeated charges.
